name: Xuē Míng & Xuē Yǐng
source:
Eccentric, rule-breaking twins who enjoy playing pranks.

They often wear masks that conceal their faces, so it's difficult to tell the two apart. However, upon closer inspection, one can discern the vivacious and unpredictable nature of the older brother, Luke. This contrasts with the comparatively calm and dependable personality of his younger brother, Kieran.
